transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started. We've got the draft collateral reinvestment plan in front of us — the full $25 million into 30-day commercial paper from Delta Financial. Before I give final authorization, I need to hear from each of you. Counterparty risk, compliance, client coverage, and investment operations — please give me your one-minute exception reports. I need to know if there are any issues with Delta Financial, any client or compliance constraints, and any operational concerns. If everything comes back clean, I'll authorize. If not, I'm prepared to consider an alternative plan today, provided it clears all of your requirements.

transcript.text: I have an exception to report. In a counterparty review I completed this morning, I confirmed that Delta Financial's commercial paper is under active rating review. Until that review closes, desk policy prohibits any new purchase of Delta commercial paper. I recorded the result in my working file, but the counterparty system has not been updated yet, which is why it may not be visible to the rest of you.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I have a compliance exception to report. I found this week in the applicable collateral-investment mandate that the cash may be placed only in government Treasury bills or AAA-rated bank certificates of deposit, each with a maturity of no more than 14 days. This restriction has not yet been added to the desk's pre-trade checklist, which is why it hasn't been flagged until now. The proposed investment in 30-day commercial paper from Delta Financial would violate this mandate on two counts: it's neither a government Treasury bill nor an AAA-rated bank CD, and the 30-day maturity exceeds the 14-day maximum.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I have a client coverage exception to report. I received a client instruction confirmed by email this morning requiring $7,000,000 of this collateral pool to remain uninvested cash because the client expects a possible securities-loan recall. I have not yet attached the email to the reinvestment ticket, which is why it hasn't been flagged in the system.

transcript.text: I have an operations update to report. I confirmed with the settlement team today that our platform can process exactly $12,000,000 of Treasury bills and $6,000,000 of AAA bank certificates of deposit on a T+1 basis, with daily position reconciliation. This capacity confirmation is in an operations note that has not yet been circulated. So if an alternative plan is considered, operations can support up to $18,000,000 across those two eligible asset types on a T+1 basis.
